title: He Will Wipe Away Every Tear

request.style: English, Norwegian revival song of longing for heaven, an older male voice with a mixed congregation in harmony, accordion, guitar and mandolin, slow waltz in 3/4, homesick and hopeful, 80 BPM, sung in English
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I heard a voice from the throne
Look, God's dwelling is with us
He will dwell with his own
And they will be his people

[Chorus]
He will wipe away every tear
From our eyes up there
And death will be no more
No more grief or crying or pain

[Verse]
When I walk my final road
And my journey here is done
Then I will see him as he is
And be at home with God

[Chorus]
He will wipe away every tear
From our eyes up there
And death will be no more
No more grief or crying or pain
